context: Mei takes Sho-young to a small festival; lots of energy and joy.
purpose: Mother and child experiencing festive happiness.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お母さん、屋台、たくさん!
lines.en: Mom — there are so many stalls!
lines.style: Bright, unfiltered excitement. Quick intake of breath before speaking. Bouncing energy on each word, eyes wide. No filter between observation and voice.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.en: Yeah, festivals are fun, aren't they?
lines.style: Warm, indulgent smile in the voice. Soft, unhurried pace. Looking at him more than the stalls. A mother folding his excitement into her own calm joy.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Urgent but not whiny. Rising pitch on the want. Small body tensing with anticipation. The singleness of a six-year-old's desire — nothing else exists right now.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.en: Let's watch the bon dance a little later, okay?
lines.style: Gentle redirect with no resistance in it. Soft, encouraging. A promise tucked into the words. Not dimming his excitement — redirecting it forward.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: Yes! It just keeps getting fun!
lines.style: Infectious joy, slightly breathless. Immediate, unselfconscious. Pitch stays up. The kind of happiness that doesn't need to prove itself.
